items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I'll never forget George McCollum pick up a number... everybody just followed him in it... George McCollum left the band when his wife was going to have a kid

ctx.x: Yeah. How did that work? I never heard about this.

We'd come over here to play a dance and we'd make an advertisement on the truck just like we used to advertise in the Orleans. And I'll never forget George McCollum pick up a number and nobody would know what he was playing. And he didn't know it either, but it sounded something good. And everybody just followed him in it, you know. He followed him and went on to play it, took chorus and everything. It sounded good. So after we finished, I asked George, I said, what's the name of that number? George said, well…
